name: locale-auto-select-single-locale-modern-debug
description: Issue #18 sprint 4: WHAT #8's 'one enabled en auto-select no visible selector (default config)' milestone. Boots the default (en-only) modern debug ROM from a real ExpansionUserPrefs UNSET sub-state fixture (outer ExpansionSaveMeta already SAVE_COMPAT_CURRENT, so BuildCurrentExpansionSaveMeta()'s blank-chip auto-stamp never runs -- see tools/gba-playtest/tests/locale_prefs_fixture.py) -- a real reachable state ExpansionUserPrefs_Normalize() classifies as requiresPrompt=TRUE. With enabledLocaleCount==1, ExpansionLanguageMenu_DecideStartupAction returns AUTO_SELECT: the sole enabled locale (en) is silently stored (ExpansionUserPrefs_Store, cacheGeneration 0->1) and the blocking selector's own active flag never becomes 1 -- gExpansionLanguageMenuProbe shows autoSelected=1, promptReason=1 (UNSET), promptShown=0, active=0.
